instruction.name: vavgr.b
instruction.description: Compute the average (rounded towards positive infinity) of corresponding signed 8-bit elements in `a` and `b`, save the result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vavgr.b $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vavgr.b $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vavgr.b $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vavgr.b $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vavgr.b $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vavgr.b $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vavgr.b $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vavgr.b $vr7, $vr15, $vr23

throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr16, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr17, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr18, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr19, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr20, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr21, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr22, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr23, $r4' --asm 'vavgr.b $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vavgr.b $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vavgr.b $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vavgr.b $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vavgr.b $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vavgr.b $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vavgr.b $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vavgr.b $vr7, $vr15, $vr23'
